## Complexity by time of day

[Placeholder: writing that sets up the question.]

```{python}

by_hour = hours.summary(checkouts, rng)  # averages, and the range chance alone would give
```

```{python}
charts.hour_chart("Average complexity by time of day", by_hour, [1.8, 2, 2.2, 2.4, 2.6, 2.8])
```
